### Installation

Install the extension from the [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/ejpgoohpgnpfaldileagfncgmknnajno): Chrome keeps it up to date. This version
reaches the store once Google has reviewed it.

Where the store is out of reach, use the zip below instead:

1. Download the `symfony-chrome-plugin-<version>.zip` file below and unzip it into a folder you keep.
2. Open `chrome://extensions` and turn on **Developer mode**.
3. Click **Load unpacked** and pick the unzipped folder.
4. Open DevTools on your application, then the **Symfony** tab.

To update a zip installation, replace the folder's contents with the new release, then click the
extension's reload icon in `chrome://extensions`.
